description: seed.plan is a read: it returns the plan an apply WOULD make for a set (and, optionally, the keys to scope it), writing nothing — the spy-pinned read (S43-extra T6, SD6, SD10). The result is the field-for-field twin of the engine's plan: per-record decisions (op = apply | update | skip | restore | retire | adopt, with fromVersion/toVersion and the reason) and a plan-level refusal (a downgrade) that fails the whole apply before any write, spoken verbatim.
